title: Agent Task Tools
description: Agents should have tools for creating, updating, and commenting on tasks. Change status, priority, add attachments, etc.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented MCP task tools backed by the existing ITaskService path: memorysmith_task_list, memorysmith_task_get, memorysmith_task_create, memorysmith_task_update, memorysmith_task_set_status, memorysmith_task_add_comment, and memorysmith_task_add_attachment. The tools are MCP-only, share task-service validation/persistence/history, and write tools remain gated by edit permission through the existing MCP risk check. Updated README and the API/MCP feature page. Validation passed: focused McpTaskTools_ListAndMutateTasks regression passed 1/1; broader McpAndSemanticSearchTests plus AppApiContractTests slice passed 43/43; editor diagnostics reported no errors in the touched code/test files.
